// Notes
// - cpu_ms is frame start to submit-return: the batcher CPU cost, and the
//   number DESIGN.md §7 quotes. total_ms adds SDL_WaitForGPUIdle.
// - net_cpu_ms subtracts a measured empty-frame baseline (acquire, clear,
//   submit, wait with no draw), so it is the marginal cost of the bucket
//   rather than the fixed cost of a frame.
// - Check vulkan_icd above before treating total_ms as a hardware figure.
//   A software ICD (dzn, lavapipe, swiftshader) makes it a fill-rate
//   measurement of the host CPU, not of a GPU.
// - Median of 31 frames after 10 warm-up frames, per N.
// - nonblack_px is the smoke test: a fast frame that drew nothing would
//   be a broken bench, so the probe exits non-zero if it is 0.
